__comment: Log doors: 2/3 blocks single leaf, 4 blocks double leaf. Eight voxels per block, 31 voxels tall below a four-block lintel.
Doors stay walkable. RoomManager seals every footprint column regardless of cosmetic hinge state. All variants use the same placement, hauling and uninstall pipeline.
description: One rough log leaf swings open as dwarves approach. Fits a 3-block-wide opening and seals the room for warmth.
